scope: Autonomous idle research: curiosity trigger, LLM research selection/planning, restricted tools, web/memory/files/code/experiments/papers, synthesis/persistence, E-PQ reinforcement, runtime integration and evidence/authority semantics

non_overlap_check.boundary: This shard owns the autonomous research orchestration/evidence pipeline. Prior Projects authority and context/tool-routing receipts own general agent authority and active prompt/tool-surface semantics.

chronology.finding: Introduced idle-triggered autonomous research: model decides whether a thought is research-worthy, generates up to 10 tool calls, executes a restricted list, synthesizes, stores a memory and emits an autonomy reward. Initial limits: 15min idle, 1h cooldown, max5/day. The source described tools as low-risk/read-only despite including memory_store and sandboxed code execution.
chronology.interpretation: Strong precursor for curiosity-driven slow-loop research, but the safety description was broader than the actual effect set.

chronology.finding: Audit found autonomous research memory persistence had been POSTing to a nonexistent /memory/store endpoint (404); it was replaced by a direct consciousness.db reflection write. Missing threading import was also fixed.
chronology.interpretation: Historical negative result: a research pipeline can appear complete while its durable-memory edge is silently nonfunctional. End-to-end receipt/readback tests are mandatory.

chronology.finding: A later deep audit again records autonomous research HTTP 404 repair via direct Titan Python calls, alongside several other dormant/dead learning-path fixes.
chronology.interpretation: Repeated endpoint drift strengthens the case for typed in-process contracts or schema-tested service APIs plus execution receipts, rather than stringly endpoint assumptions.

chronology.finding: Frozen-head autonomous_research.py is still present and consciousness_daemon calls _maybe_autonomous_research every third idle-thought cycle. Current limits include 15min idle, 30min cooldown, max5/day; the allowed set expanded to experiment/hypothesize/test_hypothesis/paper_search/paper_read and web_fetch uses a curated domain whitelist.
chronology.interpretation: Unlike the CRG shard, this mechanism has a verified frozen-head integration hook. Code-level activation is established; actual session frequency/effect still requires runtime/DB evidence.

confirmed_negative_results_constraints.claim: Initial autonomous-research memory persistence was nonfunctional because it called a nonexistent /memory/store endpoint; this was later repaired.
confirmed_negative_results_constraints.current_lesson: Every research run needs write + reread/lookup verification of durable artifacts.

confirmed_negative_results_constraints.claim: Frozen-head autonomous code execution is not fail-closed with respect to sandbox availability: autonomous_research invokes code_execute with skip_approval=True, while ToolExecutor explicitly returns the raw inner command when Firejail is unavailable and warns execution will be unsandboxed.
confirmed_negative_results_constraints.qualification: The unsafe branch is conditional on Firejail being unavailable. Presence/absence on the historical live host is not established by source alone.
confirmed_negative_results_constraints.falsifier: A frozen runtime receipt proves Firejail was always present and independently enforced, or a lower-level OS sandbox confined code even on this fallback branch.

confirmed_negative_results_constraints.claim: The 'read-only/low-risk' description is semantically false for the implementation: memory_store is a write, code_execute can produce side effects, and later experiment/hypothesis/paper tools may mutate local research state.

Frozen-head research persistence is synthesis-centric rather than evidence-complete: research_sessions stores question/plan/tool-count/synthesis/status, while step outputs are concatenated/truncated and synthesis input is truncated; durable per-step raw source bodies/hashes/source classes/claim links are not represented in this module's session schema.
confirmed_negative_results_constraints.qualification: Other services may independently log some tool activity; this module does not establish an evidence-complete research lineage.

confirmed_negative_results_constraints.claim: The frozen-head research-decision prompt is deliberately biased toward triggering research ('say true unless purely emotional'), so session caps limit resource use but do not create an epistemic value-of-information policy.

Emitting an autonomy/personality reward after completed synthesis rewards research activity/completion, not independently verified epistemic quality; this signal must not be treated as evidence that the findings are correct.

reusable_candidates.mechanism: idle curiosity -> research-worthiness decision -> bounded plan -> synthesis
tool allowlist plus web domain whitelist

architecture_delta.preferred_testable_shape: curiosity/question candidate -> value-of-information gate -> typed research plan with declared capabilities/evidence requirements -> fail-closed capability executor -> immutable per-step raw evidence receipts -> source-class/claim extraction -> contradiction/negative-result preservation -> synthesis as derived object -> validated memory promotion -> optional intrinsic reward tied to process quality, not truth
architecture_delta.evidence_law: synthesis != evidence; every synthesis sentence promoted to memory must retain source/claim lineage or be explicitly model inference/hypothesis

branch_feedback.frank: DELTA: preserve curiosity-driven slow-loop research, but route curiosity to proposals rather than direct authority. Reward process novelty/discipline separately from factual truth. Require source-linked memory promotion.
branch_feedback.harness: HIGH-PRIORITY: add fail-closed sandbox tests; no sandbox must mean no autonomous code. Add end-to-end persistence write/readback tests, per-tool evidence receipts, resource budgets and source-provenance assertions.
branch_feedback.claycode: DELTA: encode research plan steps as typed capability requests with source/evidence contracts; code execution, memory writes, experiments and paper reads are distinct effects and must never share a generic 'read-only' label.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: DELTA: research_run -> step -> tool_request -> raw_evidence -> source_hash/class -> claim/negative_result -> synthesis -> memory_promotion lineage should be first-class; summaries are derived projections.
branch_feedback.claygraph: DELTA: research findings enter as provenance-weighted claim nodes/relations, not immediate truth edges. Conflicts and failed tool paths remain retrievable.
branch_feedback.gwt: DELTA: autonomous research is a plausible slow-loop re-entry mechanism that can feed future workspace competition; it is not evidence of consciousness by itself.
branch_feedback.emergenz: DELTA: research/experiment loops provide interventions for lesion/rescue and hypothesis testing, but autonomous question generation alone is not causal emergence evidence.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: DELTA: competing research hypotheses/evidence interpretations should remain set-valued until discriminating tests resolve them.
branch_feedback.clay: DELTA: if research organs dissolve into Clay, retain capability/evidence/provenance semantics even when process boundaries disappear.
branch_feedback.q12_index: DELTA: autonomous-research lineage is historically reusable; no new historical-hour credit before row-level deduplication.

runtime_activation.integration: services/consciousness_daemon.py invokes _maybe_autonomous_research(text) every third idle-thought count and calls services.autonomous_research.get_research().maybe_research(thought)
runtime_activation.rule: Do not infer historical runtime frequency/effect without DB/log evidence.
